## Checklist

- [ ] I dedicate this contribution to the public domain under [CC0 1.0](../LICENSE), and I have the right to do so.
- [ ] Nothing was copied from IMDb, Amazon X-Ray, Tunefind, fan wikis, TMDB text or any other source whose licence does not allow it. Trivia is in my own words and cites a source.
- [ ] Machine-generated entries carry `source` and `confidence`, and `reviewed: true` only where I checked them myself.
- [ ] No biometric data (face embeddings, voice prints) is included.
- [ ] `python tools/validate.py` passes.
